title: Can't Remember New Words? Link Each One to a Scene #shorts
description:
Can't remember new words? Link each one to a scene.
• Cautious: a driver on an icy road
• Curious: a cat opening a box
• Stubborn: a donkey that won't move
• Generous: a grandma serving a second helping
• Clumsy: knocking over a glass of water

Which picture will you remember tomorrow? Tell me in the comments.

Find more words on anotherwordfor.net
